notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Kitsune's Paths - Demo Updates!
Version 1.1

Hi there! Thanks so much for playing the demo of Kitsune’s Paths. We’ve been working hard to improve the experience, and today we’re bringing you a new update packed with content and improvements.

What’s New:

- 19 new languages added - The demo is now available in even more languages so more players around the world can enjoy it. (this is in early stages, so please share any feedback for your native language)

- New Encyclopedia - Unlock entries about enemies, mechanics, and more as you play.

- Save System - You can now save and load your progress with 3 separate save slots.

- Numbers! we added damage numbers for each hit.

- New sound effects - We've added audio to enhance the atmosphere and gameplay.

- Visual effects - New and improved VFX bring more life to each level.

- New zoom in! Get up close and enjoy the art like never before.

- Fixed minor bugs.

- Improved performance on some devices.


Thank you so much for all the feedback you’ve been sharing. This is just the beginning, and every comment helps us make Kitsune’s Paths a better game. 💖
Follow us for more updates, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

The Torbellino Games Team.

notes.title: Updates for the Demo are coming soon!
notes.content:
We’ve been hard at work on some incredible new features for Kitsune's Paths, and we can’t wait to share them with you!

[list]
[*] A fully detailed encyclopedia for both creatures and turrets, with in-depth descriptions of health, speed, and other vital stats! For turrets, you'll also find detailed info on different damage types, speed, and elemental effects.
[*] A brand-new resistance/armor system for enemies, adding even more strategy to your battles!
[*] Real-time visible damage numbers to make every hit feel even more impactful.
[*] Fresh, improved animations to bring everything to life.
[*] Exciting new sound effects and music to set the perfect atmosphere.
[*] A new save system with 3 save slots, so you can keep track of multiple playthroughs!
[*] We’re really excited about these updates and can’t wait for you to experience them.
[/list]
